# laravelforge_server_php_max_upload_size (Data Source)

Fetches the PHP max upload size (`upload_max_filesize` / `post_max_size`) for a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose PHP max upload size is fetched.

### Read-Only

- `max_upload_size` (Number) Maximum upload size in megabytes.
